result.title: Any-Rate: Half-Bit Multi-Precision LLM Quantization with Coded Bit-Planes
result.comment: 41 pages, 17 figures. (Equal contribution : Hoonki Lee and Haechan Shin)
result.summary: Nested multi-precision quantization derives multiple precisions from a single checkpoint by reading only the leading bits of each weight, which makes it attractive for on-device deployment under varying memory and energy budgets. However, existing methods offer only integer bits, leaving large accuracy gaps between adjacent precisions and severe degradation at 2 bits. To address this, we propose Any-Rate, which serves 2-8 bits from one checkpoint, in half-bit steps over 2-4 bits. Any-Rate restricts some bit-planes to extended Hamming codewords in 8-weight blocks (0.5 bits per weight), shares one LUT per row across precisions, and encodes all precisions jointly with a separate target for each, reducing the loss from sharing bit-planes. Across four LLMs, Any-Rate achieves state-of-the-art accuracy among multi-precision methods at 2 and 3 bits, keeping 69% of FP16 accuracy at 2 bits, and is within one point of the best at 4 bits. It decodes about as fast as existing kernels, and an LPDDR energy model estimates up to 27% less energy at equal accuracy. Code is available at https://github.com/hoonki2002/Any-Rate.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 Any-Rate，用扩展 Hamming 码字约束部分 bit-plane 并跨精度共享 LUT，从单一 checkpoint 提供 2–8 bit、2–4 bit 范围内半比特步进的嵌套多精度量化。
